description: This file declares the interface for an image management module in the Wesnoth game, including image caching, locating, loading, and manipulation functions, as well as related classes and enums.

classes.name: image::locator
classes.description: A class that abstracts the location of an image, supporting different types and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: image::manager
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing the lifecycle of images, including setup and cleanup.

methods.name: load_from_disk
methods.description: Loads the image pointed to by the locator from disk.

methods.name: set_colour_adjustment
methods.description: Adjusts the RGB values added to scaled images for day/night effects.

methods.name: get_colour_adjustment
methods.description: Retrieves the current colour adjustment RGB values.

methods.name: set_image_mask
methods.description: Sets a mask image to be blitted onto scaled images.

methods.name: set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format used by images, called when video mode changes.

methods.name: set_zoom
methods.description: Sets the scaling factor for images.

methods.name: get_image
methods.description: Retrieves the surface for an image, with specified type and colour adjustment.

methods.name: get_image_dim
methods.description: Retrieves a scaled image with specific dimensions.

methods.name: get_alternative
methods.description: Gets an alternative image locator based on an existing one.

methods.name: register_image
methods.description: Registers an image with a specific locator, taking ownership.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if an image exists without loading.

methods.name: getMinimap
methods.description: Creates a minimap surface for a given map.
